messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning kernel+quant bundle deploy tomorrow during the 09:00-12:00 UTC change window. Goal: ship matmul kernel v3 + q8 build. Need pin/rollback plan and release-note bullets.

deploybot: scheduled rollout created by sam for engine/matmul:v3+q8 at 2623540000 (canary -> staged -> global).

olivia: quick question — did perfbench run against our long-tail seq lengths? last time q8 regressed at 4k.

sam: yes ran perfbench+kv-cache sim. 99p latency looked fine in staging but saw token-level jitter at 3.6k sequences. we're gating with a 5% canary for 30m, will monitor p50/p95/p99 and OOMs.

pranav: define rollback criteria now pls. suggest: (1) p99 > baseline + 30% for 10m, (2) new OOM count > 3 in 15m, (3) error-rate increase > 0.5%. If any hit -> immediate pin to previous engine:v2.

taylor: +1 to those. also suggest pin TTL = 4h for any emergency pin so we don't forget to unpin after investigation. command to pin: 
```
deploybot pin --target engine:v2 --scope region=global --ttl 4h --reason "rollback after kernel v3"
```

maria: release notes checklist: models impacted, perf delta table, known regression risks (4k seq jitter), canary time & owners, rollback cmd + who to page. I'll draft the bullet list.

olivia: telemetry plan — I'll enable a focused histogram for kv-cache hit ratio + a trace sampler for sequences >3k during canary. ops-bot can emit alerts on 10s tail latency.

ops-bot: monitor rule created: engine_tail_latency_10s_alert -> notify #eng-oncall and sam if p99 > threshold for 10m.

sam: owners: canary watch = olivia/pranav, staged -> taylor, global -> maria. Communication: if rollback criteria met, pin immediately and post in this thread + #incidents.

deploybot: preflight checks: binary-sign ok, compat-check passed for primary drivers, quant-check failed on one libc variant in eu-west-1 (non-fatal). mark eu-west-1 as holdback for initial 24h?

pranav: yes, hold eu-west-1 for the first rollout stage. we'll do a targeted test there after 24h. add to release notes: "eu-west-1 holdback due to libc variant".

sam: final call — proceed with schedule, canary 5% 30m, staged 25% 1h, global ramp. eu-west-1 excluded. maria will publish release notes pre-deploy. olivia/pranav stand by for alerts. :thumbsup:

maria: noted, drafting release-note PR now. will include rollback commands and contact list.

sam: thanks — tagging @deploybot to start in morning and ping this thread on each stage transition.

deploybot: acknowledged. will post at each stage entry/exit and include deploy artifacts link: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/engine-matmul-v3-q8/2623
